It supports web and mobile applications, internally developed systems, vendor solutions, Microsoft Power Platform applications, POS integrations, transactional platforms, reporting solutions and operational systems across Pedros and its associated brands. The role must independently test whether client interactions, renewal processes, claims support, member queries, employer reporting, consulting, solution and technical deliverables and experiences meet ASI’s defined service promise, whilst monitoring and improving employee service behaviours, with particular attention to first-point-of-contact (including reception). From a Business Enablement perspective, this role should create a direct line of sight between service quality, client retention, operational discipline and profitability.
